description: This file defines internal structures, constants, and function prototypes for the private implementation of an equalizer filter module (LVEQNB) in an audio processing library. It includes type definitions, instance structure, and function declarations related to filter setup, coefficient calculation, and bypass handling.

methods.name: LVEQNB_SetFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter parameters for the equalizer instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_SetCoefficients
methods.description: Calculates and sets the filter coefficients for the equalizer instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_ClearFilterHistory
methods.description: Clears the filter state/history for the equalizer instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_SinglePrecCoefs
methods.description: Calculates single-precision filter coefficients based on filter definition.

methods.name: LVEQNB_DoublePrecCoefs
methods.description: Calculates double-precision filter coefficients based on filter definition.

methods.name: LVEQNB_BypassMixerCallBack
methods.description: Callback function for bypass mixer transitions.
